title: Kids See Explainer Slots Left Before They Even Ask | vitalii.no
description:
Explainer videos for kids run on one shared family Claude subscription with a weekly limit, but kids had no way to know whether asking would actually produce a video soon, waste a turn, or just queue silently — the only feedback came after they had already recorded and sent the question.

I added a CapacityLine component to the Explain page that reads a weekly and current-moment capacity object computed by a new runner process, and shows a plain-language line right above the recording button: how many explainers are left this week, when the next slot opens if the subscription is busy, and when the weekly count resets — with the message's color shifting from neutral to an orange busy state or a red nearly-out state depending on the numbers.

Four separate numbers — this week's count, right now, the next slot, and the weekly reset — that used to live only in the code are now folded into one plain-language line a child can read before they ever ask.
